description: Technical Specification Requirements for Consent Server

statement.label: requirement-69
statement.requirement:
Consent Administration Service MAY return OperationOutcome for a successful operation

I believe they are referring only to extended operations defined by the IG.

statement.label: requirement-68
statement.requirement:
Consent Administration Service SHOULD return OperationOutcome with details of which business rules did not allow an operation to be successful if an HTTP status code of 4xx or 5xx is returned

I believe they are referring only to extended operations defined by the IG.

statement.label: requirement-62
statement.requirement:
Consent Administration Service SHALL support File Consent operation

Redundant with CapStmt

statement.label: requirement-101
statement.requirement:
Consent Administration Service SHALL support Revoke Consent operation

Redundant with CapStmt

statement.label: requirement-63
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL support Consent search

statement.label: requirement-64
statement.requirement:
Consent Administration Service SHALL support Consent subscriptions (as defined by the FAST Subscription Topic for FHIR R4 with Subscriptions Backport)

Fix: "a consent administration service SHALL support subscriptions to allow other systems to be informed when consents for a patient have changed." - this should be more precise, like "a consent administration service SHALL support subscriptions as defined by the FAST Subscription Topic, e.g. to allow other systems to be informed when consents for a patient have changed."

statement.label: requirement-727
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL set Consent status element to 'active' when a File Consent operation has succeeded.

statement.label: requirement-634
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL set Consent status element to 'inactive' when a Revoke Consent operation has succeeded.

statement.label: requirement-760
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL NOT delete a Consent resource as a result of a Revoke Consent operation.

statement.label: requirement-71
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL support Consent search by patient

statement.label: requirement-364
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL support Consent search by FASTConsentController

statement.label: requirement-367
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL support Consent search by FASTConsentManager

statement.label: requirement-365
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL support Consent search by date

statement.label: requirement-73
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL support Consent search by status

statement.label: requirement-201
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL support Consent search by scope

statement.label: requirement-827
statement.requirement:
Consent Administration Service SHALL be able to record disclosures of when a consent was accessed to determine whether patient information could be accessed

- Need to clarify which system has the responsibility for calling this - assuming Consent Client, calling the CAS. - For now, assuming client calls after accessing.

statement.label: requirement-828
statement.requirement:
Consent Administration Service SHALL be able to retrieve disclosures of when a consent was accessed to determine whether patient information could be accessed

- Need to clarify which system has the responsibility for calling this - assuming Consent Client, calling the CAS. - For now, assuming client calls after accessing.

statement.label: requirement-1166
statement.requirement:
Systems SHALL create a FAST Consent Audit Event via a RESTful FHIR POST AuditEvent whenever a Consent instance is accessed to determine whether patient information can be accessed

See 7.2.6.1 - not always the Consent Admin Service, so if we test this in a workflow with a CAS, need to allow a different configurable actor to be the one that POSTs.

statement.label: requirement-1163
statement.requirement:
For disclosure events, implementers SHOULD follow the IHE Basic Audit Log Patterns (BALP) guide, specifically the patterns for data disclosure audit events. This guide does not define a custom profile for disclosure events; IHE-BALP patterns should be used directly.

Requires a separate analysis task

statement.label: requirement-1164
statement.requirement: Consent Administration Service SHALL support AuditEvent search by Consent (entity)

statement.label: requirement-298
statement.requirement:
Consent Administration Service SHALL support AuditEvent search by patient

Need to specify actor(s). For now, assuming CAS SHALL support and Consent Client MAY support
